findings.description: SYS-SAFE-007 requires the safe state to remain latched until a power-on reset, and SYS-SAFE-009 retains the latch across software and watchdog resets. After such a reset, SYS-SAFE-005 requires the status signal to be driven high when start-up checks pass and no fault has been detected, even if the latch remains set. The latched safe state requires that signal to be low under SYS-SAFE-001.
findings.requested_change: Make the operational status output requirement consistent with the retained safe-state latch, including after software and watchdog resets.
